  bash /tmp/hipengine-merge-qual-env.sh "$PY" scripts/gguf_prefix_reuse_gate.py \

    --sampler-mode "$sampler" \
    --prompt-file benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl \
    --prompt-category "$category" \
    --json "$OUT/prefix-state-$category.json" \
    > "$OUT/prefix-state-$category.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
  printf '%s gate exit %s\n' "$category" "$status"
  if [[ "$status" -gt 1 || ! -f "$OUT/prefix-state-$category.json" ]]; then
    exit 1

import json
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from hipengine.server import ServerConfig, create_app
from scripts.gguf_mtp_api_gate import _generated_ids, _mtp_output_accounting_contract


out = Path("/tmp/hipengine-merge-qualification/sampled-serving.json")
prompts = [
    json.loads(line)
    for line in Path("benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()
    if line.strip()
]
config = ServerConfig(
    model="/home/lhl/models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf",
    backend="hip_gfx1151",
    served_model_name="merge-qualification",
    eager_load=True,
    startup_chat_smoke=False,
    startup_scratch_probe=False,
    speculative_mtp_serving="auto",
    speculative_mtp_thinking="hint",
    max_active_requests=4,
    max_context_tokens=8192,
    kv_storage="bf16",
    execution_profile="production",
)
rows = []
with TestClient(create_app(config)) as client:
    ready = client.get("/ready")
    assert ready.status_code == 200
    for prompt in prompts:
        bodies = []
        for enabled in (False, True, True):
            response = client.post(
                "/v1/chat/completions",
                json={
                    "model": "merge-qualification",
                    "messages": prompt["messages"],
                    "max_tokens": 16,
                    "temperature": 0.7,
                    "top_p": 1.0,
                    "seed": 4242,
                    "speculative_mtp": enabled,
                },
            )
            assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
            bodies.append(response.json())
        contracts = [body.get("hipengine", {}).get("speculative_mtp", {}) for body in bodies]
        ids = [_generated_ids(body) for body in bodies]
        accounting = [
            _mtp_output_accounting_contract(body, contract)
            for body, contract in zip(bodies[1:], contracts[1:], strict=True)
        ]
        row = {
            "id": prompt["id"],
            "category": prompt["category"],
            "ar_used_mtp": bool(contracts[0].get("used")),
            "sampled_used_mtp": [bool(c.get("used")) for c in contracts[1:]],
            "repeat_exact": ids[1] == ids[2],
            "accounting_passed": accounting,
            "generated_ids": ids,
            "contracts": contracts,
        }
        rows.append(row)
        out.write_text(json.dumps({"performance_claim": False, "rows": rows}, indent=2))
        print(prompt["id"], row["sampled_used_mtp"], row["repeat_exact"], accounting, flush=True)
    final_ready = client.get("/ready")
    assert final_ready.status_code == 200

passed = all(
    not row["ar_used_mtp"]
    and all(row["sampled_used_mtp"])
    and row["repeat_exact"]
    and all(row["accounting_passed"])
    for row in rows
)
out.write_text(json.dumps({
    "schema": 1,
    "kind": "merge_sampled_serving_smoke",
    "performance_claim": False,
    "task_quality_claim": False,
    "passed": passed,
    "rows": rows,
    "ready_after": final_ready.json(),
}, indent=2))
assert passed, "sampled serving qualification failed; inspect sampled-serving.json"
